facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post '5 essential retargeting campaign tips' was published on December 7, 2021.

StackAdapt recommends excluding users who have already converted on the primary action from retargeting campaigns, while retargeting them is acceptable for a secondary conversion point if they have not completed the primary action.
facts.quote: It is strongly recommended to exclude users who have already converted on your campaigns to ensure you are truly connecting

facts.fact: StackAdapt advises setting the retargeting audience lookback window longer when a campaign is having issues with scale.
facts.quote: It is always good to set the lookback window for retargeting a bit longer if the campaign is having issues with scale.

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends starting with smaller budgets for retargeting and larger budgets for prospecting to help grow the cookied audience pool, then gradually shifting more investment to retargeting as campaigns run longer.
facts.quote: It is recommended to start off with smaller budgets for retargeting and larger budgets for prospecting to help grow the cookied audience pool.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that bidding higher on retargeting helps maximize scale and conversion opportunities, and that higher bids need not increase total spend because the retargeting pool is smaller and more defined.
facts.quote: Bidding higher in order to reach these users helps maximize your scale and creates better opportunities to deliver conversions.
